info.title: Turbo Notify Public API
info.description: Turbo Notify Public API for WhatsApp messaging

get.description: Basic health check.

Readiness check with dependency verification.

Executa todos os checkers em paralelo. Retorna 503 quando qualquer
check **crítico** falha; falhas em checks não-críticos viram
``degraded`` mas mantêm o probe verde (200).
Liveness check (for Kubernetes).

get.description: List messages for the main number inbox (cursor-paginated, newest first).

post.description: Send a message from the main number.

get.description: Return the message quota state for the main number.

post.description:
Reply to a message from the main number.

The recipient is inferred from the original message direction:
- Outbound original → reply goes to the same contact / group.
- Inbound original → reply goes to the sender.

Add or remove a reaction on a message via the main number.

The ownership guard asserts the message belongs to the main inbox.

get.description: Retrieve message details, asserting the message belongs to the main number.
Get delivery status, asserting ownership by the main number.
List reactions, asserting the message belongs to the main number.
List receipts, asserting ownership by the main number.

post.description: Edit a sent message, asserting ownership by the main number.
Delete a sent message, asserting ownership by the main number.
Send a typing indicator from the main number.

get.description: List contacts for the main number inbox.
Return the contact quota state for the main number.
Retrieve a single contact, asserting it belongs to the main number.
Resolve the profile picture for a contact in the main number inbox.

post.description: Queue a metadata refresh for a contact in the main number inbox.

get.description: List groups for the main number inbox.
Retrieve a single group, asserting it belongs to the main number.
Resolve the group picture, asserting ownership by the main number.

delete.description:
Delete (schedule deletion of) an extra number.

If the number is eligible for a 72h refund, deletion is immediate.
Otherwise, the number is scheduled for deletion at the end of the
current billing cycle and remains active until then.

get.description: List messages for the inbox identified by ``alias`` (cursor-paginated, newest first).

post.description: Send a message from the number identified by ``alias`` (``main`` or an extra alias).

get.description: Return the message quota state for the inbox identified by ``{alias}``.

post.description:
Reply to a message from the number identified by ``alias``.

The recipient is inferred from the original message direction:
- Outbound original → reply goes to the same contact / group.
- Inbound original → reply goes to the sender.

Add or remove a reaction from the number identified by ``alias``.

The ownership guard fetches the message first and asserts that the
``number_alias`` on the result matches ``alias`` — preventing a caller
from reacting to a message that belongs to a different inbox.

get.description:
Retrieve the full details of a message by its public ``msg_{hex}`` id.

The ``{alias}`` is validated against the organization before the query so
an attacker cannot enumerate messages from a different number by guessing
IDs.  After the query the ``number_alias`` in the result is checked against
``alias`` to prevent cross-number information leakage.
Get delivery status for a sent message by its public message_id.
List all active reactions to a message.
List delivery receipt history for a message (status transitions, ASC).

post.description: Edit a previously sent message by its public ``msg_{hex32}`` id.
Delete (revoke) a previously sent message by its public ``msg_{hex32}`` id.

Send a typing indicator from the number identified by ``alias``.

The sender is inferred from the URL ``alias``; the ``from`` body field
is not required (and ignored if supplied — the path always wins).

get.description: Return a cursor-paginated list of contacts for the inbox ``{alias}``.
Return the contact quota state for the inbox identified by ``{alias}``.
Retrieve a single contact, asserting it belongs to inbox ``{alias}``.
Resolve the contact's profile picture, asserting ownership by ``{alias}``.

post.description: Queue a WhatsApp metadata refresh for a contact in inbox ``{alias}``.

get.description: Return a cursor-paginated list of groups for the inbox ``{alias}``.

Retrieve a single group for the inbox ``{alias}``.

The ``number_id`` on the group row is checked against the resolved number
so that a caller cannot fetch a group belonging to a different inbox
within the same organisation (ADR 2026-06-22, Fix 4).  When ``number_id``
is ``None`` (legacy rows without the column populated) the guard is
skipped — org-level isolation is still enforced by the use case.
Resolve the group's profile picture for inbox ``{alias}``.

ContactListResponse.title: ContactListResponse
ContactListResponse.description:
List of contacts plus an opaque next cursor.

``cursor`` is the token to pass back as ``?cursor=…`` on the next
request; ``None`` when the listing is exhausted. ``has_more`` is a
DX redundancy — clients can rely on ``cursor is not None`` but the
explicit boolean keeps loops trivial.

ContactQuotaResponse.title: ContactQuotaResponse
ContactQuotaResponse.description:
Organization's current contact-quota snapshot.

Shape matches ``05-public-api-endpoints.md`` § 05.3:

.. code-block:: json

   {
     "used": 87,
     "quota": 1000,
     "remaining": 913,
     "window_days": 30,
     "resets_at": "...",
     "tier": "SOLO"
   }

ContactResponse.title: ContactResponse
ContactResponse.description:
Single-contact detail response (flat phone post-collapse).

``picture`` is a :data:`ProfilePicturePayload` discriminated union
(``kind``: ``"available"`` | ``"unavailable"``).
``None`` when no picture metadata has been fetched yet.

2026-06-06: ``push_name`` renamed to ``name`` (coherence with the
``contact.*`` event triple ``{id, name, number}``). Removed
``organization_id`` (the API is already organization-scoped — implicit),
``source`` (internal discovery detail), ``profile_picture_fetched_at``
(internal fetch marker — the ``available`` picture variant already
carries its own ``fetched_at``), and the low-value fields
``status_about``, ``is_business``, ``business_profile``, ``last_seen_at``.

EventResponse.title: EventResponse
EventResponse.description:
A single item in the :class:`ListEventsResponse` list.

Unified envelope (2026-06-01 spec) — same fields on webhook and
polling channels:

- ``id``: evt_{hex32} event identifier.
- ``type``: WebhookEventType value.
- ``organization_id``: org_{hex32} — the organization's public identifier.
- ``number_alias``: the organization number ("inbox") handle — ``"main"`` or an
  extra alias — immediately below ``organization_id``; omitted for
  organization-scoped events with no single number (ADR 2026-06-19).
- ``created_at``: ISO 8601 with organization timezone offset (fallback UTC).
- ``data``: Shared ``EventData`` subclass — byte-identical on both
  channels.

Removed (2026-06-01): ``object``, ``request_id``, ``timestamp``.

ExtraNumberSummaryResponse.title: ExtraNumberSummaryResponse
ExtraNumberSummaryResponse.description:
Per-item summary for ``GET /numbers`` (list).

Canonical NUMBER identity prefix (ADR 2026-06-19 follow-up):
``contact_id, name, type, alias, number`` then the surface-specific
``description``/``status`` tail.

GetExtraNumberStatusResponse.title: GetExtraNumberStatusResponse
GetExtraNumberStatusResponse.description:
``GET /numbers/{alias}`` — canonical NUMBER identity shape.

Field/wire order (ADR 2026-06-19 follow-up):
``contact_id, name, type, alias, number, status, at`` then the
surface-specific tail (``description``, ``scheduled_deletion_at``,
``reason``, ``pairing``).

GetMainNumberResponse.title: GetMainNumberResponse
GetMainNumberResponse.description:
``GET /numbers/main`` — canonical NUMBER identity shape.

Field/wire order (ADR 2026-06-19 follow-up):
``contact_id, name, type, alias, number, status, at``.

GetMessageDetailsResponse.title: GetMessageDetailsResponse
GetMessageDetailsResponse.description:
``GET /v1/messages/{id}`` response.

Unified with the webhook/polling event shape (2026-06-01 spec):

Common fields (all ``message.*`` events):
- ``id``: public ``msg_{hex32}`` identifier.
- ``organization_id``: ``org_{hex32}`` — the owning organization (after ``id``).
- ``number_alias``: organization inbox handle (``"main"`` / extra alias), after
  ``organization_id``. Replaces the dropped ``inbox`` party block.
- ``from``/``to``: direction-aware party shapes.
- ``preview``: permanent grapheme-aware crop (≤ 50 chars).
- ``content_type``: ``text``, ``image``, ``audio``, etc.
- ``direction``: ``"outbound"`` or ``"inbound"``.
- ``channel``: always ``"whatsapp"``.
- ``origin``: ``"tn"`` (API send), ``"native"`` (WhatsApp direct/inbound).
  Always present — never ``null``.
- ``at``: ISO 8601 — stable WhatsApp occurrence moment (does not advance
  with delivery state; outbound = sent_at, inbound = created_at proxy).
- ``status``: ``{state, at, error}`` — ``status.at`` is the advancing
  current-delivery-status time (read_at → delivered_at → sent_at → failed_at
  → created_at).  ``error`` is the nested ``MessageError``
  (``{code, message, hint}``), present iff ``state="failed"``.
- ``mentions`` (ADR 2026-07-03): ``[{contact_id?, name?, number}, ...]`` —
  hydrated ``@<number>`` mentions found in ``text``/the media ``caption``,
  inbound AND outbound, stored order.  ``None`` when the message has no
  mentions.  Survives the ``content`` retention purge (mirrors
  ``quoted_message_id``).

Type-specific optional fields (one per ``content_type``):
- ``text``: full text for ``content_type="text"``.
- ``image``, ``video``, ``audio``, ``document``, ``sticker``: media
  objects including the discriminated ``media`` block (``kind`` field).
- ``location``: ``{latitude, longitude, name?, address?, …}``.
- ``calendar``: ``{name, start_at, …}``.
- ``replied``: ``{message_id, preview}`` — for reply messages.

For ``message.reacted``: ``content_type="text"``, ``text`` = emoji or ``""``.

Removed (2026-06-01): ``body``, ``body_expired``, ``sent_at``,
``delivered_at``, ``read_at``, ``updated_at``, ``quoted_message_id``
(top-level), ``media`` (top-level — moved into type-specific objects).
Removed (ADR 2026-06-19): ``inbox`` party block — superseded by the flat
``number_alias`` handle.

GroupListResponse.title: GroupListResponse
GroupListResponse.description:
List of groups plus an opaque next-page cursor.

``cursor`` is ``None`` when the listing is exhausted. ``has_more``
mirrors ``cursor is not None`` for DX convenience.

GroupResponse.title: GroupResponse
GroupResponse.description:
Public representation of a WhatsApp Group for the API consumer.

Intentionally omits:
- ``whatsapp_group_id`` (raw WA protocol identifier — internal)
- ``parent_whatsapp_group_jid`` (internal community identifier)
- ``picture_url`` / ``picture_hash`` (worker-internal WA CDN hints)
- ``last_metadata_sync_at`` (internal cache-freshness marker — TN
  implementation detail; ``updated_at`` already signals row changes)
- ``deleted_at`` (admin-only)

InteractiveHeaderInput.title: InteractiveHeaderInput
InteractiveHeaderInput.description: Header of an interactive message — text-only in MVP.

MessageError.title: MessageError
MessageError.description:
Structured error for a failed message operation.

THE single error shape across every surface that reports a failure —
the webhook ``data.error`` (failed events) and the public API
``status.error`` (``GET /v1/messages/{id}``, ``GET .../status``, and the
send/edit/delete/reply responses). Present only when the message state is
``failed``; ``null``/absent otherwise.

Invariant — coherence:
    This model is defined ONCE here and reused by both the webhook
    contracts and the public-api response schemas. Do not fork a local
    copy; a divergent error shape is exactly the incoherence this model
    exists to prevent.

Fields:
    code: Stable machine-readable identifier — consumers branch on this
        (e.g. ``media_fetch_failed``, ``unsupported_media_format``,
        ``reaction_lid_unavailable``). Never localised, never reworded.
    message: Human-readable summary of what went wrong.
    hint: Actionable, no-PII remediation guidance. Derived from ``code``
        (+ content type) via the shared ``error_hint`` service, so the
        event and the resource always carry the same hint. ``None`` when
        no guidance applies.

MessageListResponse.title: MessageListResponse
MessageListResponse.description: Cursor-paginated list of messages for one number inbox.

MessageQuotaResponse.title: MessageQuotaResponse
MessageQuotaResponse.description:
A number's current message-quota snapshot.

.. code-block:: json

   {
     "used": 1234,
     "quota": 10000,
     "remaining": 8766,
     "window_days": 30,
     "resets_at": "...",
     "tier": "SOLO"
   }

OrganizationListResponse.title: OrganizationListResponse
OrganizationListResponse.description:
One-item list of organizations for the authenticated organization.

The public-api is single-organization: exactly one organization is returned.
``cursor`` is always ``None`` and ``has_more`` is always ``False``.

OrganizationResponse.title: OrganizationResponse
OrganizationResponse.description:
Public representation of the authenticated organization's organization.

Exposes only safe fields — anti-ban bypass flags and billing overrides
are admin-only and never present here (see :class:`OrganizationSnapshot`).

OutboundRecipientInput.title: OutboundRecipientInput
OutboundRecipientInput.description:
``to`` field on outbound message requests — number XOR group_id XOR contact_id.

Accepts EXACTLY ONE of:
- ``number``: E.164 phone for 1:1 messages.
- ``group_id``: TN public ``grp_{hex32}`` for WhatsApp Group sends.
- ``contact_id``: TN public ``ct_{hex32}`` — phone resolved server-side
  from the Contacts table.

Supplying more than one or none yields a 422 ``invalid_recipient`` error.

OutboundSenderInput.title: OutboundSenderInput
OutboundSenderInput.description:
``from`` field on outbound message requests — alias XOR number.

On the request side either ``alias`` (e.g. ``"main"`` or an extra
number alias) or ``number`` (E.164 phone) is provided — never both.
The :class:`SenderResolver` translates this input into the canonical
domain :class:`OutboundSender` value object before persistence.

ProfilePictureAvailable.title: ProfilePictureAvailable
ProfilePictureAvailable.description:
Profile picture is accessible via a signed URL.

``url_expires_at`` is set for presigned URLs and ``None`` for
permanent public URLs.  Consumers should re-fetch via the contacts
API after the URL expires rather than caching indefinitely.

``hash`` is the hex-encoded SHA-256 of the picture bytes —
stable across re-uploads of the same image, useful for dedup.

``fetched_at`` records when the worker last fetched the picture
from WhatsApp — useful for freshness heuristics.

ProfilePicturePending.title: ProfilePicturePending
ProfilePicturePending.description:
Profile picture upload to organization storage is in progress.

``hash`` may be present when the worker already computed the
SHA-256 of the fetched bytes at dispatch time.

ProfilePictureUnavailable.title: ProfilePictureUnavailable
ProfilePictureUnavailable.description:
Profile picture cannot be served.

``reason`` vocabulary:

* ``"no_storage"`` — organization has no BYO Object Storage configured.
  ``setup_hint`` is always present.
* ``"upload_failed"`` — upload failed after all retries.
  ``setup_hint`` is ``None``.
* ``"peer_has_none"`` — the contact has not set a profile picture.
  ``setup_hint`` is ``None`` (no storage action needed).
* ``"storage_circuit_open"`` — circuit breaker open; uploads
  suspended.  ``setup_hint`` is present.

Invariant: ``setup_hint is not None IFF reason in
{"no_storage", "storage_circuit_open"}``.

ReactionFromPayload.title: ReactionFromPayload
ReactionFromPayload.description: The ``from`` party of a reaction item.

ReactionItem.title: ReactionItem
ReactionItem.description: A single active reaction to a message.

ReceiptFromPayload.title: ReceiptFromPayload
ReceiptFromPayload.description:
The party who emitted a delivery/read receipt.

``number`` is ``None`` for LID (Linked-Device) receipts where the acker's
phone is unavailable. The ``from`` object is still returned when
``contact_id`` or ``name`` are known even without a phone number.

ReplyMessageRequest.title: ReplyMessageRequest
ReplyMessageRequest.description:
``POST /v1/numbers/{alias}/messages/{message_id}/reply`` request body.

Both recipient (``to``) and sender number are inferred: the recipient
comes from the original message direction; the sender is the ``{alias}``
URL segment.  Only ``content`` is required.

SendAudioContent.title: SendAudioContent
SendAudioContent.description:
Send an audio file or voice note via a public URL.

WhatsApp ignores captions on audio — the field is intentionally
absent to avoid silent data loss.

SendCalendarContent.title: SendCalendarContent
SendCalendarContent.description:
Schedule a calendar event. Maps to WhatsApp ``eventMessage``.

``start_at`` and ``end_at`` are timezone-aware ISO-8601 datetimes
(Pydantic ``AwareDatetime`` rejects naive inputs at the boundary).

SendContactContent.title: SendContactContent
SendContactContent.description:
Share a contact card. Maps to WhatsApp ``ContactMessage``.

The vCard sent on the wire is generated server-side from these
structured fields (see ``vcard_builder.build_vcard`` in the worker).
Clients never craft the vCard themselves — keeps escaping correct
and the produced contact compatible with WhatsApp's parser.

SendContactEmail.title: SendContactEmail
SendContactEmail.description: Single email entry of an outbound contact card.

SendContactPhone.title: SendContactPhone
SendContactPhone.description: Single phone entry of an outbound contact card.

caption.title: Caption
caption.description: Optional caption. Supports the same `@<number>` mention tokens as text bodies (normalized digits, echoed in `mentions` — ADR 2026-07-03).

SendDocumentContent.title: SendDocumentContent
SendDocumentContent.description: Send a document (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, etc.) via a public URL.

caption.title: Caption
caption.description: Optional caption. Supports the same `@<number>` mention tokens as text bodies (normalized digits, echoed in `mentions` — ADR 2026-07-03).

SendImageContent.title: SendImageContent
SendImageContent.description: Send an image via a public URL. WhatsApp supports JPEG, PNG, WebP.

SendInteractiveContent.title: SendInteractiveContent
SendInteractiveContent.description:
Interactive message — CTA URL only.

``interactive_type`` is a one-value discriminator kept for forward
compatibility (and to anchor the JSON shape consistent with the
storage VO). ``url_button`` is required.

See ADR ``2026-05-14-remove-whatsapp-interactive-buttons-list``.

SendLocationContent.title: SendLocationContent
SendLocationContent.description: Pin a geographic point. Maps to WhatsApp ``LocationMessage``.

SendMessageRequest.title: SendMessageRequest
SendMessageRequest.description:
``POST /v1/messages`` request body.

``to`` identifies the recipient (phone XOR group_id).
``content`` is the message payload — variant is inferred from field
presence (see :data:`SendMessageContent` and :func:`_discriminate_content`).
``quoted_message_id`` is optional — supply a ``msg_{hex32}`` to quote an
existing message without using the dedicated ``/reply`` endpoint.

The sender number is determined by the ``{alias}`` URL segment of
``POST /v1/numbers/{alias}/messages`` — there is no ``from`` field in
the request body.

SendStickerContent.title: SendStickerContent
SendStickerContent.description:
Send a sticker via a public URL (animated WebP recommended).

WhatsApp ignores captions on stickers — the field is intentionally
absent to avoid silent data loss.

text.title: Text
text.description: Message body. `@<number>` tokens (7-15 digits, e.g. `@5511973117056`) become real WhatsApp @mentions of that user: detected implicitly, normalized to canonical E.164 digits, and echoed in the message's `mentions` structure (ADR 2026-07-03).

caption.title: Caption
caption.description: Optional caption. Supports the same `@<number>` mention tokens as text bodies (normalized digits, echoed in `mentions` — ADR 2026-07-03).

SendVideoContent.title: SendVideoContent
SendVideoContent.description: Send a video via a public URL. WhatsApp supports MP4, 3GPP.

StorageSetupHint.title: StorageSetupHint
StorageSetupHint.description:
Guidance payload embedded in unavailable-media or unavailable-picture events.

Invariant: emitted ONLY when ``reason`` is ``"no_storage"`` or
``"storage_circuit_open"`` — i.e. cases where the organization can take a
corrective action (configure or fix storage).  ``upload_failed`` is
a transient infrastructure error where the hint would be misleading
(the integration is configured but failed on a specific attempt).

Fields:
    setup_url: Deep link into the dashboard storage-setup flow.
    docs_url: Link to the public documentation page for BYO Object
        Storage configuration.
    message: Short English seed string suitable for display or
        further localisation (e.g. ``"Configure your media storage
        to receive inbound media files."``).
